passages.text: O my Lord, you alone are our king: help me who am destitute, and have no helper but you, for my danger is near at hand.
passages.note: alone and in danger; prayer for help

passages.text: O god, who has power over all, hearken to the voice of the desperate, and deliver us from the hand of them that devise mischief; and deliver me from my fear.
passages.note: desperation and fear; prayer for deliverance
